# Draft:Edward Bradford Bailey

E. B. Bailey should link here
Edward Bradford Bailey (December 20, 1854 – April 28, 1923) was a state legislator in Florida. He lived in Monticello, Florida. He served in the Florida House of Representatives and Florida Senate. He also served as mayo of Monticello, Florida.
His father, William Bailey, fought in the War of 1812, Seminole Wars, and served during the American Civil War.
He was involved in the cotton business.
He died April 28, 1923, at his home in Monticello.
